description: Fix parameter-literal alignment for dms-keyed and selective-filter hand-written queries (Q22/Q39/Q62/Q99 already use d_month_seq is_between(dms, dms+11); check Q69/Q80/Q87 and any query whose default param literal selects zero rows at SF=0.01 while the SQL template literal selects rows).
